# P10 complete Catalyst form: private native Go/HTTP rehearsal

Implements the first native stage of [ADR-0044](../adr/0044-native-catalyst-settings-composition.md).
**Not certified, not a sixth catalog/CLI adapter, not a consumer migration.**
The complete five-section purchased composition is privately transformed into templ;
the original React reference remains independently available. No new dependency,
installation, host registration, commit, deployment or real data was used here.

## What now works

| Surface | Evidence and boundary |
|---|---|
| Complete composition | Organization name, bio, email/visibility, address/country/region, currency and actions retained; native selects use the source Currency wrapper. No generic substitute form. |
| Deterministic transform | Exact 32,710-byte prepared DOM/hash admission, collision-checked markers, narrow existing syntax translator and repeat output comparison. Normal generation uses Go/templ, not React/Node/an LLM. |
| Typed state | Owned option snapshots; strict field/byte/UTF-8 framing; 240-codepoint bio counting including valid U+FFFD; deliberate example ASCII email policy; canonical country/region/currency validation. |
| Native editing | All canonical country-qualified region groups exist without JavaScript. Invalid drafts remain visible; error IDs/focus and repeated instances are checked. |
| Native HTTP | Real buffered templ output, bounded POST, exact host/origin/referrer checks, cookie/CSRF validation, explicit reset and retained-draft synthetic503 seam. No persistence/backend claimed. |
| Browser tasks | Two final runs each pass78 assertions at390/1440 light/dark with scripts disabled. Eight final screenshot pairs match byte-for-byte. This is scoped Chromium evidence. |
| Keyboard safety | Enter validates instead of resetting. A separate hidden transport form owns native Reset; the visible action stays in its original location. Native Reset restores initial state/focus, not same DOM identity. |

First-party files live under `internal/designadapt/catalyst*` and
[fixtures/catalyst-settings-adapter](fixtures/catalyst-settings-adapter/README.md).
Paid bodies, source classes, screenshots and fonts remain in the ignored private store.
The renderer is not a public kit component or an application settings/auth service.

## Browser evidence and retained failures

Chrome152.0.7977.84, Playwright1.63.0, macOS arm64,1200px height, reduced motion.
Every state snapshot waits for font readiness then a fixed50ms external timer. It
never polls for success or moves focus; this observation barrier is not latency proof.
The final runner and assertions are identical for the old/new Enter regression runs.

| Retained directory under `data/design-assets/` | Observed result |
|---|---|
| `p10-native-browser-6xWH3o` | Original immediate observation missed native autofocus after POST;12 checks before failure. Six separate probes observed correct autofocus; the original result remains failed. |
| `p10-native-browser-WXrLYQ` | Attempted two-frame observation stalled with scripts disabled. The confirmed owned Chrome was closed; collector writes failure, not pass. |
| `p10-native-browser-VOULCq` | Final runner against old binary: Enter posts Reset and discards the edited name;10 checks before failure. |
| `p10-native-browser-k6CuXk`, `p10-native-browser-4vmFKE` | Separate-reset repair passes78 checks twice; eight screenshot pairs match. |
| `p10-native-browser-VYenBB`, `p10-native-browser-116KwH` | Final invalid-option-label refinement also passes78 checks twice; eight screenshot pairs match. No browser exceptions or forbidden requests. |

Final report hashes:
`e0451226b7ec2cbc9bc876a47a4fa7eaeede9a27f72d247e416341c13adf7dd4` and
`0d7f4ed7e9d1439deeb4d46a8d3dd697bfaa8919e2d94f8627dad27927422aef`.
Shared plan SHA256: `bc3db22174b7457288449b4bce80e611d5b2955d18fa3e9bb760bcdd583170f2`.

Review inspected desktop light/default and phone dark/error specimens. A narrow
invalid-region option initially hid its actual value behind “Current value”; it now
starts with the retained value and labels it invalid. Native popups and default
checkbox appearance are platform-owned. The isolated outer frame uses browser surface
colors, not the original demo's app shell. No source/target pixel-equivalence claim.
The first page can request an unimplemented favicon and receive404; response logs
retain it. “No browser exceptions” does not mean every resource returned200.

The Enter defect is [INC-27](../intent/incidents.md). Structural canaries fail when
Reset is re-associated with the edit form; the actual browser test proves why it
matters. The early setup/font-license failure and compiler/test-instrumentation
failures remain private; none were accepted as target evidence.

## Verification and remaining work

`TestCatalystPrivateCompiledForm` passes actual-source generation, isolated race tests,
HTTP tests and binary build. `TestCatalystNativeStructureCanaries` checks actual
disabled attributes rather than falsely rejecting retained `disabled:*` CSS classes.
`TestCompleteSourceMultipleInstances` rejects leftover static Headless label IDs.
Source-only policy/view tests separately pass without paid input; the explicitly
authored view stub does not stand in for the real form. `TestCatalystSyntheticHTTPFixture`
keeps the real native handler tests in the ordinary source-only gate.
Final source-only race checks pass: `internal/designadapt`28.221s and
`cmd/appkit-mcp`23.465s; both packages pass `go vet`. Scoped intent-doctor checks
cover15 documents' links, root living-doc budgets,44 ADR memberships and matching
intent stanzas, with no failures. This is not a full intent/host wiring audit.

Subsequent [optional local feedback and same-node reset](2026-09-14-catalyst-enhancement.md) have separate proof. Still open: physical
input/zoom/contrast/accessibility and performance matrix, browser-level503 recovery,
complete source-fidelity review, revision-bound private delivery/catalog exposure,
vendor-upgrade replay and real-consumer integration. Paid licensing/access restrictions
remain. Legacy439/657 compiler/DOM coverage, five catalog candidates and zero certified
targets are unchanged; G1–G6 remain active.
